name: covera
description: Runs Suresoft COVER EE coverage builds from natural-language requests: identifies the original build for C/C++, C#, and Java projects (CMake, Make, Visual Studio/MSBuild, STM32CubeIDE, Maven, Gradle), performs and verifies the instrumented build, and keeps the verified setup for later builds. Also collects coverage memory dumps from STM32CubeIDE debug sessions and diagnoses C/C++ analysis errors with toolchain configuration fixes. Requires a COVER EE Local Agent installation.
